newsitem.title: USA: MAPCO buys 2 Florida propane retailers.
newsitem.headline: MAPCO buys 2 Florida propane retailers.

text.p: MAPCO Inc said it bought two independent retail propane companies based on Florida's east coast.

Tri-County Gas, which has facilities in Fort Pierce, Stuart, Vero Beach and Okeechobee, Fla., and Econ-O-Gas of Jupiter, Fla., will add more than 11,000 customers and 8.2 million gallons in annual sales to MAPCO's retail propane marketing business, Thermogas Co.
Tri-County's Vice President Dave Satur will become the Thermogas market area manager for the facilities.
The new locations mark Thermogas' first entry into mid-south Florida. It already markets propane in the Florida panhandle.

The retail propane purchases are the eighth and ninth for MAPCO over the past 120 days. Collectively, the nine transactions have added about 26,000 customers and 24 million gallons in annual sales to Thermogas. The nation's fourth largest propane retailer, it now serves more than 375,000 customers through 175 locations in 16 states.
